title.headline: 80 claims a year. One chronology each.

end.line: Quillon for Whitlock Barnes’s construction group

vo: Whitlock Barnes’s construction group handles about eighty delay and defect claims a year. Here is that work in Quillon.
Quillon builds the delay chronology from thousands of site emails, and every event links back to its source.
Vault reviews every site record at once, so notices and defect reports come back flagged in one table.
Ask what the contract says on extensions of time, and the answer is cited to the page.
George will walk your team through it on Friday the twentieth.
